adds.title: Matthew Shepard and James Byrd Jr. Hate Crimes Prevention Act (federal)
adds.summary: On October 28, 2009, the federal Matthew Shepard and James Byrd Jr. Hate Crimes Prevention Act was signed into law, adding gender/transgender status to federal violent hate-crime coverage and authorizing federal prosecutors to partner with states to prosecute such bias-motivated violence to the fullest.

adds.title: Human Dignity Trust
adds.summary: In Mauritania, Penal Code 1983 Article 306 punishes public outrage against Islamic decency with 3 months to 2 years imprisonment and a fine and Article 264 punishes inciting debauchery with up to 6 months imprisonment, both applied to gender non-conformity, with in January 2020 ten people arrested after a birthday video where arrests were justified as for "imitating women" leading to eight convictions for indecency and inciting debauchery sentenced to 2 years imprisonment reduced on appeal in March 2020 plus one woman receiving a 1-year suspended sentence for being present, and in October 2021 police harassed a transgender woman, stripping her and threatening investigation for "fake breasts".
